sn17.4:1.3: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave dīghalomikā eḷakā kaṇṭakagahanam paviseyya
sn17.4:1.4: sā tatra tatra sajjeyya tatra tatra gaṇheyya tatra tatra bajjheyya tatra tatra anayavyasanaṃ āpajjeyya || 4
sn17.4:1.5: Evam eva kho bhikkhave idhekacco bhikkhulābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūto pariyādiṇṇacitto pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati ||
sn17.4:1.6: so tatra tatra sajjati tatra tatra gayhati tatra tatra bajjhati tatra tatra anayavyasanam āpajjati || || 5
sn17.4:1.7: Evaṃ dāruṇo kho bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe|| || 6
